//: Emits the declaration tree the converter reads as each component's API contract.
nexus-assets is an app: it builds with noEmit and ships no types, so without this the converter
finds no .d.ts anywhere and every component's props collapse to `[key: string]: unknown` -- which is
exactly what the design agent codes against. With it, Button arrives carrying variant, size, asChild
Scoped to ds-src (no leading dot -- tsc's include globs skip dot-directories), so tsc follows the barrels and emits only the published surface plus whatever it
transitively needs. Regenerated by cfg.buildCmd; web/.ds-types/ is gitignored.
rootDir is load-bearing, not tidiness. declarationDir lays the tree out relative to the program's
common root, so ONE input file outside web/ moves that root to the repo root and sinks every emitted
.d.ts one level below the path index.d.ts names -- no error, no missing file, just 178 contracts that
silently become `[key: string]: unknown`. Pinning it turns that into a tsc error at the stray import.
